__NOTOC__ Mangeclaw is a "huge Ice Claw Bear" mob that can be found just east of the road to South Gate Pass, at the far eastern end of Dun Morogh. The stench of this bear's mangy coat and rotten breath are nearly enough to send a person reeling. Mangeclaw also seems to be a patient hunter, having stalked siege engine pilot Mori Hildelve for two and a half days before it finally charged him from behind and chewed up his leg. Mana wyrms are small, simple, glowing critters that float around feeding off of stray pockets of arcane energy. More worms than wyrms, they are mainly found in Quel'Thalas, some Outland zones such as Netherstorm, Suramar, and the Azure Span. In addition to Azeroth, they also live on Argus, having thrived there many millennia ago.

Mana pool is a term which refers to a character's total amount of mana by mana points. Most characters who use mana strive to increase this amount though different mana-increasing factors, which usually makes "mana pool" the result - or sum - of these factors. A character's mana pool and base mana will be the same (have the same values) if the player isn't affected by any such factor. For example, a level 60 character may have a mana pool of 6000, while a 85 character may have 100000. Albeit a large mana pool is useful to all classes using mana, it is considered especially important for healers.
